name: Uesugi Keijirou
source:
Jinyou living in Kamizawa, and vice-chairman of its academy's student council. His height is really short, which resulted in him having Napoleon complex (alias "short man syndrome"), but basically he's a lad brimming with vitality. Childhood friends with the Ichinotani siblings and the student council accountant, [url=/c331]Nanami Io[/url].
His youkai ancestor is a giant species called [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Daidarabotchi]Daidarabotchi[/url] (a giant youkai touted to have created many geographical features in Japan), which grants him powers whereas he can't feel the weight of anything he grasps. His parents are managing a small, cheap, but delicious soba shop, where he often has to help out by doing deliveries and such.
